| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean |  | Disabled rules are kept but never applied. · default `true` |
| `name` | string \| null |  | max length 200 |
| `method` | `"*"` \| `"registration"` \| `"spectrumInquiry"` \| `"grant"` \| `"heartbeat"` \| `"relinquishment"` \| `"deregistration"` |  | SAS method the rule applies to; * for all. · default `"*"` |
| `matchCbsd` | string \| null |  | Only requests whose cbsdId, fccId, serial number or grantId contains this text. Null: every request. · max length 300 |
| `action` | `"response_code"` \| `"patch"` \| `"http_status"` \| `"delay"` \| `"drop"` \| `"malformed"` | yes | `response_code`: replace each matching response object's responseCode (success-only fields are removed for a non-zero code). Needs `responseCode`; `responseMessage` and `responseData` are optional. `patch`: JSON-merge-patch `responseData` (an object) into each matching response object. `http_status`: answer the whole request with this HTTP status (`httpStatus`) and `responseData` as the body. `delay`: wait `delayMs` before answering. `drop`: close the connection without answering. `malformed`: answer with truncated JSON. |
| `responseCode` | integer \| null |  | With action response_code. · ≥ 0, ≤ 1000 |
| `responseData` | any |  | response_code: responseData; patch: the merge patch (object); http_status: the response body. |
| `responseMessage` | string \| null |  | With action response_code. · max length 1000 |
| `httpStatus` | integer \| null |  | With action http_status. · ≥ 100, ≤ 599 |
| `delayMs` | integer \| null |  | With action delay. · ≥ 0, ≤ 600000 |
| `remaining` | integer \| null |  | Apply this many more times, then stop. Null: no limit. · ≥ 0 |

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The rule. | [FaultRule](#schema-faultrule) |

| 401 | No valid credentials (unauthorized), or the account is disabled (account_disabled). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The caller's role or API key does not allow this (forbidden), a browser request came from an origin that is not allowed (origin_not_allowed), or a web page reached the SAS by an unknown host name (host_not_allowed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 404 | The resource does not exist (not_found). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 409 | The resource is in a state that does not allow this (conflict). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |

## Logs

The wire log of every exchange, the event log, exports and the live Server-Sent Events stream.

| Method | Path | Operation | Scope | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/messages` | [listMessages](#listmessages) | read | List wire-log exchanges |
| DELETE | `/messages` | [clearMessages](#clearmessages) | write | Clear the wire log |
| GET | `/messages/export` | [exportMessages](#exportmessages) | read | Export the wire log |
| GET | `/messages/{id}` | [getMessage](#getmessage) | read | Get a wire-log exchange |
| DELETE | `/messages/{id}` | [deleteMessage](#deletemessage) | write | Delete a wire-log exchange |
| GET | `/events` | [listEvents](#listevents) | read | List events |
| DELETE | `/events` | [clearEvents](#clearevents) | write | Clear the event log |
| GET | `/events/export` | [exportEvents](#exportevents) | read | Export the event log |
| GET | `/events/{id}` | [getEvent](#getevent) | read | Get an event |
| GET | `/stream` | [streamEvents](#streamevents) | read | Live event stream (Server-Sent Events) |

### listMessages

`GET /api/v1/messages` · scope **read**

**List wire-log exchanges.**

Every SAS–CBSD exchange (HTTPS, HTTP and internal), newest first, without the request and response bodies. Page backwards with `before`, or poll for new exchanges with `after`.

Example:

*The last two heartbeats.*

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "$API/messages?method=heartbeat&limit=2"
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": 14,
      "ts": 1793120788035,
      "transport": "http",
      "remoteAddr": "127.0.0.1",
      "path": "/v1.2/heartbeat",
      "method": "heartbeat",
      "version": "v1.2",
      "httpStatus": 200,
      "durationMs": 10,
      "cbsdIds": ["TEST-FCC/b7eeb0aceec6f6087a0c75b6f69289c95b3e191c"],
      "codes": [501],
      "certSubject": null,
      "error": null
    },
    {
      "id": 5,
      "ts": 1793120787704,
      "transport": "internal",
      "remoteAddr": "api",
      "path": "/v1.2/heartbeat",
      "method": "heartbeat",
      "version": "v1.2",
      "httpStatus": 200,
      "durationMs": 2,
      "cbsdIds": ["TEST-FCC/b7eeb0aceec6f6087a0c75b6f69289c95b3e191c"],
      "codes": [0],
      "certSubject": null,
      "error": null
    }
  ],
  "limit": 2,
  "order": "desc",
  "next": 5
}
```

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | `"registration"` \| `"spectrumInquiry"` \| `"grant"` \| `"heartbeat"` \| `"relinquishment"` \| `"deregistration"` |  | Only this SAS method. |
| `transport` | `"https"` \| `"http"` \| `"internal"` |  | Only this transport: https, http or internal (console and API requests). |
| `cbsdId` | string |  | Only exchanges that mention this cbsdId. |
| `code` | integer |  | Only exchanges where some response object has this responseCode. · ≥ 0 |
| `httpStatus` | integer |  | Only exchanges answered with this HTTP status (0: connection dropped). · ≥ 0 |
| `remoteAddr` | string |  | Only exchanges from this client address. |
| `errors` | boolean |  | Only failures: a transport error, HTTP status ≥ 400 or a non-zero responseCode. |
| `q` | string |  | Text search in the request, response, error and client address. · min length 1 |
| `limit` | integer |  | Maximum number of items to return (1–1000). · ≥ 1, ≤ 1000, default `100` |
| `before` | integer |  | Only items whose id is lower than this. Pass the previous page's `next` to page backwards. · ≥ 1 |
| `after` | integer |  | Only items whose id is higher than this, oldest first. Pass the previous page's `next` to page forwards (polling). · ≥ 0 |
| `since` | time (epoch ms or RFC 3339) |  | Only items at or after this time (epoch milliseconds or RFC 3339). |
| `until` | time (epoch ms or RFC 3339) |  | Only items before this time (epoch milliseconds or RFC 3339). |

Responses:

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | A page of exchanges. | object |
| 400 | The request is invalid (validation_failed, invalid_json, bad_request) or the operation was refused (operation_failed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | No valid credentials (unauthorized), or the account is disabled (account_disabled). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The caller's role or API key does not allow this (forbidden), a browser request came from an origin that is not allowed (origin_not_allowed), or a web page reached the SAS by an unknown host name (host_not_allowed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |

Response 200 body:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | array of [Message](#schema-message) | yes |  |
| `limit` | integer | yes |  |
| `order` | `"desc"` \| `"asc"` | yes | `desc` (newest first) unless `after` was given. |
| `next` | integer \| null | yes | Cursor for the next page. Newest first (desc): pass it as `before`; null when this page is the last. Oldest first (asc, polling): pass it as `after` next time; it is never null. |

```text
{"id":8,"ts":1793120787733,"transport":"internal","remoteAddr":"api","path":"/v1.2/grant","method":"grant","version":"v1…
{"id":13,"ts":1793120787980,"transport":"internal","remoteAddr":"api","path":"/v1.2/grant","method":"grant","version":"v…
```

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | `"registration"` \| `"spectrumInquiry"` \| `"grant"` \| `"heartbeat"` \| `"relinquishment"` \| `"deregistration"` |  | Only this SAS method. |
| `transport` | `"https"` \| `"http"` \| `"internal"` |  | Only this transport: https, http or internal (console and API requests). |
| `cbsdId` | string |  | Only exchanges that mention this cbsdId. |
| `code` | integer |  | Only exchanges where some response object has this responseCode. · ≥ 0 |
| `httpStatus` | integer |  | Only exchanges answered with this HTTP status (0: connection dropped). · ≥ 0 |

| `errors` | boolean |  | Only failures: a transport error, HTTP status ≥ 400 or a non-zero responseCode. |
| `q` | string |  | Text search in the request, response, error and client address. · min length 1 |

| `until` | time (epoch ms or RFC 3339) |  | Only items before this time. |
| `limit` | integer |  | Maximum rows (the newest are kept). · ≥ 1, ≤ 1000000, default `20000` |
| `format` | `"ndjson"` \| `"json"` |  | ndjson (one JSON object per line) or json (an array). · default `"ndjson"` |

Responses:

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | NDJSON or JSON file. | `application/x-ndjson` |

| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |


```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": 46,
      "ts": 1793120788099,
      "level": "warn",
      "category": "fault",
      "message": "Fault rule \"http_status\" created",
      "cbsdId": null,
      "grantId": null
    },
    {
      "id": 45,
      "ts": 1793120788044,
      "level": "warn",
      "category": "fault",
      "message": "Fault injected on heartbeat response #1: responseCode 501",
```

| `since` | time (epoch ms or RFC 3339) |  | Only items at or after this time (epoch milliseconds or RFC 3339). |
| `until` | time (epoch ms or RFC 3339) |  | Only items before this time (epoch milliseconds or RFC 3339). |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | array of [Event](#schema-event) | yes |  |
| `limit` | integer | yes |  |
| `order` | `"desc"` \| `"asc"` | yes | `desc` (newest first) unless `after` was given. |

```text
{"id":40,"ts":1793120787963,"level":"warn","category":"admin","message":"Grant 5329943951600446 suspended by administrat…
{"id":41,"ts":1793120787972,"level":"warn","category":"admin","message":"Grant 5329943951600446 resumed by administrator…
{"id":43,"ts":1793120787993,"level":"warn","category":"admin","message":"Grant 7338392050789261 terminated by administra…
```

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `level` | array of `"info"` \| `"warn"` \| `"error"` \| `"success"` |  | Comma-separated levels. Comma-separated. |
| `category` | string |  | Only this category, e.g. registration, grant, heartbeat, admin, fault, tls, api, auth. |
| `cbsdId` | string |  | Only events about this CBSD. |
| `grantId` | string |  | Only events about this grant. |
| `q` | string |  | Text search in the message. · min length 1 |
| `since` | time (epoch ms or RFC 3339) |  | Only items at or after this time (epoch milliseconds or RFC 3339). |
| `until` | time (epoch ms or RFC 3339) |  | Only items before this time. |
| `limit` | integer |  | Maximum rows (the newest are kept). · ≥ 1, ≤ 1000000, default `100000` |
| `format` | `"ndjson"` \| `"json"` |  | ndjson (one JSON object per line) or json (an array). · default `"ndjson"` |

### streamEvents

`GET /api/v1/stream` · scope **read**

**Live event stream (Server-Sent Events).**

A `text/event-stream` that stays open. Event types:

- `hello`: sent once on connect: `{"requestId", "types", "serverTime"}`.
- `event`: a new event-log entry (same fields as GET /events items).
- `message`: a new wire-log exchange (same fields as GET /messages items).
- `changed`: `{"what": "cbsds" | "grants" | "settings" | "certs" | "spectrum" | "faults" | "map" | "terrain" | "status" | …}`. Re-read that resource.

A comment line (`: ping`) is sent every 15 s to keep proxies from closing the connection.
Browsers' EventSource cannot set headers, so this route also accepts the API key as `?access_token=` (in the console the login cookie is enough).

Example:

*Follow exchanges and events live (Server-Sent Events).*

```bash
curl -sN -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "$API/stream?types=event,message"
```

Response `200` (`text/event-stream`):

```text
retry: 3000
event: hello
data: {"requestId": "8c28fded-b8bf-4603-a256-8709bb465140", "types": ["event", "message"], "serverTime": 1793120788161}

event: message
data: {"id": 15, "ts": 1793120788169, "transport": "internal", "remoteAddr": "api", "path": "/v1.2/heartbeat", "method": "heartbeat", "version": "v1.2", "httpStatus": 200, "durationMs": 3, "cbsdIds": ["TEST-FCC/b7eeb0aceec6f6087a0c75b6f69289c95b3e191c"], "codes": [0], "certSubject": null, "error": null}

event: event
data: {"id": 48, "ts": 1793120788182, "level": "info", "category": "admin", "message": "Measurement report triggers: registration=false, heartbeat=false", "cbsdId": null, "grantId": null}
```

Each `message` is a wire-log entry and each `event` an event-log entry, the same objects GET /messages and GET /events return (cut short here). A comment line (`: ping`) is sent every 15 s to keep the connection open.

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `types` | array of `"event"` \| `"message"` \| `"changed"` |  | Comma-separated event types to receive (default: all). Comma-separated. |
| `access_token` | string |  | API key, for clients that cannot send an Authorization header. |

Responses:

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Event stream. | `text/event-stream` |
| 400 | The request is invalid (validation_failed, invalid_json, bad_request) or the operation was refused (operation_failed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | No valid credentials (unauthorized), or the account is disabled (account_disabled). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The caller's role or API key does not allow this (forbidden), a browser request came from an origin that is not allowed (origin_not_allowed), or a web page reached the SAS by an unknown host name (host_not_allowed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |

### runDailyActivities

`POST /api/v1/operations/daily-activities` · scope **write**

**Run daily activities now.**

Pulls full-activity dumps from the peer SASs injected as incumbents of kind peer_sas, rebuilds PPAs and protections and expires PAL channels. With `wait=true` (default) the call returns when the run has finished (200); with `wait=false` it returns at once (202) and the status can be polled. A run already in progress is not restarted.

Example:

*Run the daily activities now and wait for them.*

```bash
curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "$API/operations/daily-activities"
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "completed": true,
  "running": false,
  "lastStarted": 1793120789136,
  "lastCompleted": 1793120789140,
  "log": ["0 grant(s) terminated"],
  "scheduled": false
}
```

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wait` | boolean |  | Wait for the run to finish. · default `true` |

Responses:

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Finished. | [DailyActivities](#schema-dailyactivities) |
| 202 | Started. | [DailyActivities](#schema-dailyactivities) |
| 400 | The request is invalid (validation_failed, invalid_json, bad_request) or the operation was refused (operation_failed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | No valid credentials (unauthorized), or the account is disabled (account_disabled). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The caller's role or API key does not allow this (forbidden), a browser request came from an origin that is not allowed (origin_not_allowed), or a web page reached the SAS by an unknown host name (host_not_allowed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |

### resetSasState

`POST /api/v1/operations/reset` · scope **write**

**Reset the SAS state.**

Deletes every CBSD, grant, registry entry (FCC IDs, user IDs, blacklist, conditional registrations, CPI users), injected incumbent, PPA and protection, and clears the triggers and flags, like the harness Reset call. Settings, certificates and fault rules are kept. `clearLogs` also empties the wire log and event log. The body must contain `"confirm": "RESET"`.

Example:

*Reset the SAS like the harness does: CBSDs, grants, registry, incumbents, PPAs and protections.*

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$API/operations/reset" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"confirm": "RESET", "clearLogs": false}'
```

Response `200`:

```json
{"reset": true, "logsCleared": false}
```

Request body (JSON, required):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `confirm` | `"RESET"` | yes |  |
| `clearLogs` | boolean |  | default `false` |

Responses:

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Done. | object |
| 400 | The request is invalid (validation_failed, invalid_json, bad_request) or the operation was refused (operation_failed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | No valid credentials (unauthorized), or the account is disabled (account_disabled). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The caller's role or API key does not allow this (forbidden), a browser request came from an origin that is not allowed (origin_not_allowed), or a web page reached the SAS by an unknown host name (host_not_allowed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |

Response 200 body:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reset` | boolean | yes |  |
| `logsCleared` | boolean | yes |  |

### getListeners

`GET /api/v1/listeners` · scope **read**

**SAS listener status.**

HTTP and HTTPS listener state: port, whether it is listening and the last error; for HTTPS also the client-certificate policy, server certificates, trust-anchor count, cipher suites and protocol versions.

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "$API/listeners"
```

```json
    "listening": true,

    "error": null,

    "ciphers": "AES128-GCM-SHA256:AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256",
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/harness/methods` | [listHarnessMethods](#listharnessmethods) | read | List harness admin methods |
| POST | `/harness/{method}` | [callHarnessMethod](#callharnessmethod) | write | Call a harness admin method |
| GET | `/harness/sas.cfg` | [getHarnessConfig](#getharnessconfig) | read | Harness sas.cfg |

### listHarnessMethods

`GET /api/v1/harness/methods` · scope **read**

**List harness admin methods.**

Every admin call of the WInnForum test harness that POST /harness/{method} accepts, and whether the SAS listeners currently accept them at <base>/admin/<method> (setting harnessAdminEnabled).

Example:

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "$API/harness/methods"
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "listenerAdminEnabled": true,
  "methods": [
    {
      "method": "reset",
      "description": "Reset the SAS state (like POST /operations/reset without clearing logs)."
    },
    {
      "method": "injectdata/fcc_id",
      "description": "{\"fccId\", \"fccMaxEirp\"}: add an FCC ID."
    },
    {"method": "injectdata/user_id", "description": "{\"userId\"}: add a user ID."},
    "… 33 more"
  ]
}
```

Responses:

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Methods. | object |
| 401 | No valid credentials (unauthorized), or the account is disabled (account_disabled). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The caller's role or API key does not allow this (forbidden), a browser request came from an origin that is not allowed (origin_not_allowed), or a web page reached the SAS by an unknown host name (host_not_allowed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |

Response 200 body:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listenerAdminEnabled` | boolean | yes |  |
| `methods` | array of object | yes |  |
| `methods[].method` | string | yes |  |
| `methods[].description` | string | yes |  |

### callHarnessMethod

`POST /api/v1/harness/{method}` · scope **write**

**Call a harness admin method.**

Runs the call exactly as the SAS does for the harness (e.g. `POST /api/v1/harness/injectdata/fcc_id` with `{"fccId": "X", "fccMaxEirp": 47}`), whether or not harnessAdminEnabled is set, and logs it in the wire log as `admin/<method>`. `result` is what the harness would receive (null when the call returns nothing).

Examples:

*Inject an FCC ID, as the harness does.*

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$API/harness/injectdata/fcc_id" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"fccId": "HARN-FCC", "fccMaxEirp": 30}'
```

Response `200`:

```json
{"method": "injectdata/fcc_id", "result": null}
```

*Ask whether the daily activities have finished.*

```bash
curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "$API/harness/get_daily_activities_status"
```

Response `200`:

```json
{"method": "get_daily_activities_status", "result": {"completed": true}}
```

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `method` | string | Admin method, e.g. injectdata/fcc_id or trigger/load_dpas (slashes are not encoded). May contain "/" (not encoded). · pattern `^[a-z0-9_]+(/[a-z0-9_]+)?$` |

Request body (JSON, optional):

Type: any. The harness request body; omit for calls that take none.

Responses:

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Result. | object |
| 400 | The request is invalid (validation_failed, invalid_json, bad_request) or the operation was refused (operation_failed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | No valid credentials (unauthorized), or the account is disabled (account_disabled). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The caller's role or API key does not allow this (forbidden), a browser request came from an origin that is not allowed (origin_not_allowed), or a web page reached the SAS by an unknown host name (host_not_allowed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 404 | The resource does not exist (not_found). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 409 | The resource is in a state that does not allow this (conflict). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |

Response 200 body:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | string | yes |  |
| `result` | any | yes |  |

### getHarnessConfig

`GET /api/v1/harness/sas.cfg` · scope **read**

**Harness sas.cfg.**

A `[SasConfig]` section for the harness pointing at this SAS's HTTPS listener.

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "$API/harness/sas.cfg?host=sas.lab.example"
```

```text
AdminApiBaseUrl: sas.lab.example:8443

SasSasRsaBaseUrl: sas.lab.example:8443
SasSasEcBaseUrl: sas.lab.example:8443
CbsdSasVersion: v1.2
SasSasVersion: v1.3
AdminId: sas_admin_id
MaximumBatchSize: 100
```

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| `host` | string |  | Host name or address the harness uses to reach the SAS (default: the first configured host name). · pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9.:\[\]-]+$` |

Responses:

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | sas.cfg | `text/plain` |
| 400 | The request is invalid (validation_failed, invalid_json, bad_request) or the operation was refused (operation_failed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | No valid credentials (unauthorized), or the account is disabled (account_disabled). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The caller's role or API key does not allow this (forbidden), a browser request came from an origin that is not allowed (origin_not_allowed), or a web page reached the SAS by an unknown host name (host_not_allowed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |

## Certificates

The lab PKI: create CAs and certificates, import PEM and PKCS#12, revoke, download in every format, sign CPI data.

| Method | Path | Operation | Scope | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/certs` | [listCerts](#listcerts) | read | List certificates |
| GET | `/certs/{id}` | [getCert](#getcert) | read | Get a certificate |
| PATCH | `/certs/{id}` | [updateCert](#updatecert) | write | Rename a certificate |
| DELETE | `/certs/{id}` | [deleteCert](#deletecert) | write | Delete a certificate |
| POST | `/certs/root` | [createRootCa](#createrootca) | write | Create a root CA |
| POST | `/certs/sub-ca` | [createSubCa](#createsubca) | write | Create a subordinate CA |
| POST | `/certs/server` | [issueServerCert](#issueservercert) | write | Issue a SAS server certificate |
| POST | `/certs/cbsd` | [issueCbsdCert](#issuecbsdcert) | write | Issue a CBSD certificate |
| POST | `/certs/cbsd-batch` | [issueCbsdCertBatch](#issuecbsdcertbatch) | write | Issue CBSD certificates in bulk |
| POST | `/certs/domain-proxy` | [issueDomainProxyCert](#issuedomainproxycert) | write | Issue a domain-proxy certificate |
| POST | `/certs/installer` | [issueInstallerCert](#issueinstallercert) | write | Issue a CPI (installer) certificate |
| POST | `/certs/import` | [importCerts](#importcerts) | write | Import PEM certificates |
| POST | `/certs/import-p12` | [importPkcs12](#importpkcs12) | write | Import a PKCS#12 file |
| POST | `/certs/{id}/revoke` | [revokeCert](#revokecert) | write | Revoke a certificate |
| POST | `/certs/{id}/unrevoke` | [unrevokeCert](#unrevokecert) | write | Clear a revocation |
| GET | `/certs/{id}/download` | [downloadCert](#downloadcert) | read | Download a certificate |
| POST | `/cpi/sign` | [signCpiData](#signcpidata) | write | Sign installation data as a CPI |

### listCerts

`GET /api/v1/certs` · scope **read**

**List certificates.**

Every certificate in the store with its subject, issuer, validity, fingerprint, key type, role, revocation and whether the SAS uses it as a server certificate or trusts it as a client CA. Private keys are never included.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `limit` | integer | yes |  |
| `offset` | integer | yes |  |

### deleteCert

`DELETE /api/v1/certs/{id}` · scope **write**

### createSubCa

`POST /api/v1/certs/sub-ca` · scope **write**

**Create a subordinate CA.**

role: `sas` (issues SAS server certificates), `cbsd` (CBSD certificates), `operator` (domain-proxy certificates) or `installer` (CPI certificates); the WInnForum role OID is added.

Example:

*A CBSD CA under it.*


### issueServerCert

`POST /api/v1/certs/server` · scope **write**

**Issue a SAS server certificate.**

`use`: `add` presents it next to the current SAS server certificates, in place of the one with the same key type (RSA or ECDSA) if there is one, since the HTTPS listener presents at most one of each; `replace` makes it the only one. Either way the HTTPS listener restarts and the call returns when it is back. Without `use` the certificate is only stored.

Example:

*A SAS server certificate for another name.*

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$API/certs/server" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "parentId": "52646b5c-ad10-4995-b55c-9964024838dd",
    "CN": "sas2.lab.example",
    "sans": ["sas2.lab.example", "192.0.2.20"]
  }'
```

### issueCbsdCertBatch

`POST /api/v1/certs/cbsd-batch` · scope **write**

**Issue CBSD certificates in bulk.**

Issues one certificate per device and returns a zip with a provisioning bundle per device (as format=bundle) plus devices.txt.

Example:

*Certificates for three radios at once (a zip of bundles).*

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$API/certs/cbsd-batch" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "parentId": "b479ab3a-21c1-4075-860d-959ad37ef9ac",
    "devices": [
      {"fccId": "TEST-FCC", "serial": "SN-0101"},
      {"fccId": "TEST-FCC", "serial": "SN-0102"},
      {"fccId": "TEST-FCC", "serial": "SN-0103"}
    ]
  }'
```

Response `200`: `application/zip`, 133,101 bytes, saved to `bundles.zip`.

Request body (JSON, required):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `parentId` | string | yes | Id of the issuing CA (must hold its private key). · min length 1 |
| `devices` | array of object | yes | min 1 items, max 1000 items |
| `devices[].fccId` | string | yes | min length 1 |
| `devices[].serial` | string | yes | min length 1 |
| `keyType` | `"rsa2048"` \| `"rsa3072"` \| `"rsa4096"` \| `"ec256"` \| `"ec384"` |  | default `"rsa2048"` |
| `days` | integer |  | ≥ 1, ≤ 36500 |
| `password` | string |  | PKCS#12 password. · min length 1, default `"cbrs"` |
| `registerFccIds` | boolean |  | default `false` |

Responses:

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Zip of bundles. | `application/zip` |
| 400 | The request is invalid (validation_failed, invalid_json, bad_request) or the operation was refused (operation_failed). | [Error](#schema-error) |

| 403 | The caller's role or API key does not allow this (forbidden), a browser request came from an origin that is not allowed (origin_not_allowed), or a web page reached the SAS by an unknown host name (host_not_allowed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 404 | The resource does not exist (not_found). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |

### importCerts

`POST /api/v1/certs/import` · scope **write**

**Import PEM certificates.**

One or more PEM certificates (e.g. a CA chain or the WInnForum harness CAs), optionally with the private key of the first. Imported CAs can then be trusted for client certificates (PUT /tls/trusted-cas).

Example:

*Import a CA certificate (PEM; add keyPem to import its key too).*

```bash
jq -n --rawfile pem partner-root-ca.pem '{pem: $pem, name: "Partner Root CA"}' \
  | curl -s -X POST "$API/certs/import" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @-
```

```json
      "id": "7d93729d-efbf-4da4-9a5f-711d4e199c2d",
```

### downloadCert

`GET /api/v1/certs/{id}/download` · scope **read**

**Download a certificate.**

Formats:

- `pem`: The certificate (PEM).
- `crt`: The certificate (PEM, .crt).
- `der`: The certificate (DER).
- `chain`: Certificate and issuing CAs, without the root (PEM).
- `fullchain`: Certificate and issuing CAs including the root (PEM).
- `crl`: A fresh CRL listing the revoked certificates this CA issued (CAs with a key only).
- `all-in-one`: Full chain followed by the PKCS#8 private key (PEM). Contains the private key: needs write access.
- `all-in-one-traditional`: Full chain followed by the PKCS#1 / SEC1 private key (PEM). Contains the private key: needs write access.
- `key`: The private key, PKCS#8 (PEM). Contains the private key: needs write access.
- `key-traditional`: The private key, PKCS#1 (RSA) or SEC1 (EC) (PEM). Contains the private key: needs write access.
- `p12`: PKCS#12 with chain (AES), protected by `password`. Contains the private key: needs write access.
- `p12-legacy`: PKCS#12 with 3DES/SHA-1 for older devices, protected by `password`. Contains the private key: needs write access.
- `bundle`: Radio provisioning zip: identity in every format and the SAS trust anchors. Contains the private key: needs write access.

Examples:

*The radio bundle: certificate, key, chains, PKCS#12 and the SAS root CA in one zip.*

```bash
curl -s "$API/certs/53e9ba60-a340-4bae-8cad-625e1297e732/download?format=bundle&password=cbrs" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -o radio-bundle.zip
```

Response `200`: `application/zip`, 48,435 bytes, saved to `radio-bundle.zip`.

*Just the certificate, PEM.*

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "$API/certs/53e9ba60-a340-4bae-8cad-625e1297e732/download?format=pem"
```

Response `200` (`application/x-pem-file`):

```text
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MIIEsTCCApmgAwIBAgIQMVpS5H1ocfliQqNtqqwU…
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
```

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Certificate id. |

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | `"pem"` \| `"crt"` \| `"der"` \| `"chain"` \| `"fullchain"` \| `"crl"` \| `"all-in-one"` \| `"all-in-one-traditional"` \| `"key"` \| `"key-traditional"` \| `"p12"` \| `"p12-legacy"` \| `"bundle"` |  | File format. · default `"pem"` |
| `password` | string |  | Password for p12, p12-legacy and bundle. · min length 1, default `"cbrs"` |

Responses:

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The file. | `application/octet-stream` |
| 400 | The request is invalid (validation_failed, invalid_json, bad_request) or the operation was refused (operation_failed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | No valid credentials (unauthorized), or the account is disabled (account_disabled). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The caller's role or API key does not allow this (forbidden), a browser request came from an origin that is not allowed (origin_not_allowed), or a web page reached the SAS by an unknown host name (host_not_allowed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 404 | The resource does not exist (not_found). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |

### signCpiData

`POST /api/v1/cpi/sign` · scope **write**

**Sign installation data as a CPI.**

Produces the `cpiSignatureData` a Category B registration carries: a JWS over the FCC ID, serial number, installation parameters and professional-installer data, signed with an installer certificate's key from the store (`installerCertId`; its CPI id and name are used when not given) or with `privateKeyPem`.

Example:

*Sign installation data as that CPI.*

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$API/cpi/sign" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "installerCertId": "d89318b7-8887-4128-bb4f-7bfe66d3187a",
    "fccId": "TEST-FCC-B",
    "cbsdSerialNumber": "SN-B002",
    "installationParam": {
      "latitude": 37.4215,
      "longitude": -122.0839,
      "height": 12,
      "heightType": "AGL",
      "indoorDeployment": false,
      "antennaGain": 15,
      "eirpCapability": 40
    }
  }'
```

Response `200`:

```json

}
```

## TLS

Which certificates the SAS HTTPS listener presents and which CAs it trusts for client certificates; the CA trust bundle.

| Method | Path | Operation | Scope | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/tls` | [getTls](#gettls) | read | SAS TLS configuration |
| PUT | `/tls/server-certs` | [setServerCerts](#setservercerts) | write | Select the SAS server certificates |
| PUT | `/tls/trusted-cas` | [setTrustedClientCas](#settrustedclientcas) | write | Select the CAs trusted for client certificates |
| GET | `/trust-bundle` | [downloadTrustBundle](#downloadtrustbundle) | read | Download the CA trust bundle |

### getTls

`GET /api/v1/tls` · scope **read**

**SAS TLS configuration.**

The server certificates presented on the HTTPS listener, the CAs trusted for client certificates (an empty list trusts every CA in the store), the TLS policy settings and the live listener state.

Example:

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "$API/tls"
```

At most one per key type (e.g. an RSA and an ECDSA certificate): the listener cannot present two of the same type. Each needs a private key. The HTTPS listener restarts; the call returns when it is back.

### importCrls

`POST /api/v1/crls` · scope **write**

**Import CRLs.**

PEM or DER, base64-encoded. Re-importing the same CRL replaces it.

Example:

*Import a CRL.*

```bash
jq -n --arg data "$(base64 -w0 cbsd-ca.crl)" '{files: [{name: "CBSD CA CRL", data: $data}]}' \
  | curl -s -X POST "$API/crls" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @-
```

Response `201`:

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "59369a89-ac9e-409a-83d3-4f5edee3ae64",
      "name": "CBSD CA CRL",
      "issuerHash": "df9035ef",
      "thisUpdate": 1793120795000,
      "nextUpdate": 1795712795000,
      "revokedCount": 1,
      "revoked": ["74E4D98C6E804BE4376951D794938728"]
    }
  ]
}
```

Each file (PEM or DER) goes in `data` as base64: `{"files": [{"name": "CBSD CA CRL", "data": "LS0tLS1CRUdJTi…"}]}`.

Request body (JSON, required):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `files` | array of object | yes | min 1 items |
| `files[].data` | string | yes | min length 1 |
| `files[].name` | string |  | max length 200 |

Responses:

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 201 | Imported. | object |
| 400 | The request is invalid (validation_failed, invalid_json, bad_request) or the operation was refused (operation_failed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | No valid credentials (unauthorized), or the account is disabled (account_disabled). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The caller's role or API key does not allow this (forbidden), a browser request came from an origin that is not allowed (origin_not_allowed), or a web page reached the SAS by an unknown host name (host_not_allowed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |

Response 201 body:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | array of [Crl](#schema-crl) | yes |  |

### startTileDownload

`POST /api/v1/map/download` · scope **write**

**Download a tile set for offline use.**

Fetches every tile of the area and zoom range from a z/x/y tile server into `<name>.mbtiles` in the tile store, in the background (202). At most 100,000 tiles; OpenStreetMap's servers are refused (their policy forbids bulk downloads). Poll GET /map/download or watch the `changed` stream for "map".

Example:

*Download that area from the USGS topo map for offline use.*

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$API/map/download" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{

    "minZoom": 10,
    "maxZoom": 13,

    "attribution": "USGS The National Map"
  }'
```

## Terrain

Elevation tiles for the Category A HAAT check: inventory, elevation and HAAT queries, downloads.

| Method | Path | Operation | Scope | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/terrain` | [getTerrain](#getterrain) | read | Terrain tiles |
| POST | `/terrain/rescan` | [rescanTerrain](#rescanterrain) | write | Rescan the terrain directory |
| GET | `/terrain/elevation` | [getElevation](#getelevation) | read | Terrain elevation at a point |
| GET | `/terrain/haat` | [getHaat](#gethaat) | read | Height above average terrain |
| GET | `/terrain/tiles-needed` | [getTerrainTilesNeeded](#getterraintilesneeded) | read | Tiles needed for HAAT at some points |
| GET | `/terrain/download` | [getTerrainDownload](#getterraindownload) | read | Current or last terrain download |
| POST | `/terrain/download` | [startTerrainDownload](#startterraindownload) | write | Download terrain tiles |
| DELETE | `/terrain/download` | [cancelTerrainDownload](#cancelterraindownload) | write | Cancel the terrain download |

### getTerrain

`GET /api/v1/terrain` · scope **read**

**Terrain tiles.**

The terrain directory (SAS_TERRAIN_DIR), the elevation tiles found there, where downloads come from, and the current download job. With no tiles, the HAAT check is skipped (and logged).

Example:

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "$API/terrain"
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "directory": "/data/terrain",
  "tileCount": 1,
  "files": [{"name": "n40w101", "file": "floatn40w101_1_std.flt", "sizeBytes": 90000}],
  "source": "https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/Elevation/1/TIFF/current",
  "download": null
}
```

Responses:

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Terrain. | [Terrain](#schema-terrain) |
| 401 | No valid credentials (unauthorized), or the account is disabled (account_disabled). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The caller's role or API key does not allow this (forbidden), a browser request came from an origin that is not allowed (origin_not_allowed), or a web page reached the SAS by an unknown host name (host_not_allowed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |

### getHaat

*Height above average terrain of a 10 m antenna, as the Category A check computes it.*

### startTerrainDownload

`POST /api/v1/terrain/download` · scope **write**

**Download terrain tiles.**

Downloads USGS 3DEP 1-arc-second GeoTIFF tiles (public domain, about 50 MB each) into the terrain directory in the background (202), three at a time, like `node server/src/tools/fetch-terrain.ts`. Give tile names, points to cover for HAAT (`around`), and/or `harness: true` for the harness test locations. Tiles already present are skipped unless `force`. Set SAS_TERRAIN_SOURCE_URL to use a mirror.

Example:

*Download a tile from USGS.*

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$API/terrain/download" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tiles": ["n10w010"]}'
```

Response `202`:

```json
{
  "state": "running",
  "directory": "/data/terrain",
  "source": "https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/Elevation/1/TIFF/current",
  "force": false,
  "total": 1,
  "finished": 0,
  "failed": 0,
  "bytes": 0,
  "tiles": [{"name": "n10w010", "status": "downloading", "bytes": null, "error": null}],
  "startedAt": 1793120796273,
  "finishedAt": null
}
```

Request body (JSON, optional):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tiles` | array of string |  | Tile names, e.g. n39w099. |
| `around` | array of object |  | Points to cover for the HAAT computation. |
| `around[].lat` | number | yes | ≥ -90, ≤ 90 |
| `around[].lon` | number | yes | ≥ -180, ≤ 180 |
| `harness` | boolean |  | default `false` |
| `force` | boolean |  | default `false` |

Responses:

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 202 | Started. | [TerrainDownloadJob](#schema-terraindownloadjob) |
| 400 | The request is invalid (validation_failed, invalid_json, bad_request) or the operation was refused (operation_failed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | No valid credentials (unauthorized), or the account is disabled (account_disabled). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The caller's role or API key does not allow this (forbidden), a browser request came from an origin that is not allowed (origin_not_allowed), or a web page reached the SAS by an unknown host name (host_not_allowed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 409 | The resource is in a state that does not allow this (conflict). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |

## Configuration

Configuration export and import, and a full database backup.

| Method | Path | Operation | Scope | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/config/export` | [exportConfig](#exportconfig) | read | Export the configuration |
| POST | `/config/import` | [importConfig](#importconfig) | write | Import a configuration |
| GET | `/system/backup` | [downloadBackup](#downloadbackup) | admin | Download a database backup |

### exportConfig

`GET /api/v1/config/export` · scope **read**

**Export the configuration.**

Settings, registry (FCC IDs, user IDs, blacklist, conditional registrations, CPI users), operator protections and PPAs, and fault rules, as one JSON document, the same file the console's Backup page saves. Certificates, CBSDs, grants and logs are not included: use GET /system/backup for everything.

Example:

*Settings, registry, protections, PPAs and fault rules as one JSON document.*

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "$API/config/export"
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "exportedAt": "2026-10-27T17:06:36.394Z",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "settings": {
    "sasHttpEnabled": true,
    "sasHttpPort": 8000,
    "sasHttpsEnabled": true,
    "sasHttpsPort": 8443,
    "tlsClientAuth": "optional",
    "tlsMinVersion": "TLSv1.2",
    "tlsMaxVersion": "TLSv1.2",
    "tlsCipherPolicy": "winnforum",
    "serverCertIds": "[…]",
    "trustedClientCaIds": [],
    "tlsCheckCrl": true,
    "certRoleCheck": "lenient",
    "rejectUnverifiedClientCert": false,
    "supportedVersions": ["v1.2"],
    "acceptVersionlessPaths": true,
    "heartbeatIntervalSec": 60,
    "transmitExpireSec": 240,
    "grantExpireSec": 604800,
    "connectivityLostSec": 604800,
    "versionErrorAsResponseCode": false,
    "siqChannelization": "none",
    "siqIncludeDpa": false,
    "strictOperationState": false,
    "responseDelayMs": 0,
    "…": "28 more"
  },
  "fccIds": ["{…}", "… 1 more"],
  "userIds": [{"user_id": "lab-user", "created_at": 1793120787858}],
  "blacklist": [],
  "conditional": ["{…}", "… 1 more"],
  "cpiUsers": ["{…}"],
  "protections": [],
  "ppas": [],
  "faults": []
}
```

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `download` | boolean |  | Send as a file attachment. · default `false` |

Responses:

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The configuration. | object |
| 400 | The request is invalid (validation_failed, invalid_json, bad_request) or the operation was refused (operation_failed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | No valid credentials (unauthorized), or the account is disabled (account_disabled). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The caller's role or API key does not allow this (forbidden), a browser request came from an origin that is not allowed (origin_not_allowed), or a web page reached the SAS by an unknown host name (host_not_allowed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |

### importConfig

`POST /api/v1/config/import` · scope **write**

**Import a configuration.**

Takes a document from GET /config/export (or the console). Settings are validated and applied, except server certificates and trusted CAs, which stay as they are on this installation (user accounts and API keys are never imported); unknown settings are skipped and listed. Rows are inserted or replaced by primary key; nothing is deleted.

Example:

*Import a configuration (here, one setting and one FCC ID).*

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$API/config/import" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "settings": {"heartbeatIntervalSec": 60},
    "fccIds": [{"fcc_id": "IMPORTED-FCC", "max_eirp": 33, "created_at": 1793120796398}]
  }'
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "settingsChanged": [],
  "settingsSkipped": [],
  "rows": {
    "fccIds": 1,
    "userIds": 0,
    "blacklist": 0,
    "conditional": 0,
    "cpiUsers": 0,
    "protections": 0,
    "ppas": 0,
    "faults": 0
  },
  "listenersRestarted": false
}
```

Request body (JSON, required):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `exportedAt` | string |  |  |
| `version` | string |  |  |
| `settings` | object |  |  |
| `fccIds` | array of object |  |  |
| `userIds` | array of object |  |  |
| `blacklist` | array of object |  |  |
| `conditional` | array of object |  |  |
| `cpiUsers` | array of object |  |  |
| `protections` | array of object |  |  |
| `ppas` | array of object |  |  |
| `faults` | array of object |  |  |

Responses:

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | What was imported. | object |
| 400 | The request is invalid (validation_failed, invalid_json, bad_request) or the operation was refused (operation_failed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | No valid credentials (unauthorized), or the account is disabled (account_disabled). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The caller's role or API key does not allow this (forbidden), a browser request came from an origin that is not allowed (origin_not_allowed), or a web page reached the SAS by an unknown host name (host_not_allowed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |

Response 200 body:

| `settingsChanged` | array of string | yes |  |
| `settingsSkipped` | array of string | yes |  |
| `rows` | object | yes |  |
| `listenersRestarted` | boolean | yes |  |

### downloadBackup

`GET /api/v1/system/backup` · scope **admin**

**Download a database backup.**

A consistent copy of the whole SQLite database (VACUUM INTO): settings, certificates and private keys, CBSDs, grants, registry, spectrum data, fault rules, logs, user accounts (password hashes) and API key hashes. To restore, stop the SAS and replace sas.db in the data directory. For admins, because it contains private keys and password hashes.

Example:

*A consistent copy of the whole database, while the SAS runs (admins only).*

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -o sasbench-backup.db "$API/system/backup"
```

Response `200`: `application/vnd.sqlite3`, 290,816 bytes, saved to `sasbench-backup.db`.

Responses:

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | SQLite database. | `application/vnd.sqlite3` |
| 401 | No valid credentials (unauthorized), or the account is disabled (account_disabled). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The caller's role or API key does not allow this (forbidden), a browser request came from an origin that is not allowed (origin_not_allowed), or a web page reached the SAS by an unknown host name (host_not_allowed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |

### getTable

`GET /api/v1/data/tables/{table}` · scope **read**

Columns (type, NOT NULL, primary key, default), indexes, row count and the CREATE statement.

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "$API/data/tables/fcc_ids"
```

Response `200`:

```json
  "name": "fcc_ids",

  "sql": "CREATE TABLE fcc_ids (\n  fcc_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  max_eirp    REAL,                         -…",
  "columns": [
    {
      "name": "fcc_id",
      "type": "TEXT",
      "notNull": false,
      "primaryKey": true,
      "default": null
    },
    {
      "name": "max_eirp",
      "type": "REAL",
      "notNull": false,
      "primaryKey": false,
      "default": null
    },
    "… 1 more"
  ],
  "indexes": [{"name": "sqlite_autoindex_fcc_ids_1", "unique": true, "columns": ["fcc_id"]}]
}
```

### listTableRows

`GET /api/v1/data/tables/{table}/rows` · scope **read**

**Read table rows.**

Raw rows (snake_case columns, JSON stored as text, timestamps in epoch milliseconds). Filter on one column with `column` and `value` (exact match) or `like` (substring). Private keys, password hashes, session IDs and API key hashes read as "[redacted]". The rows of api_tokens need write access, like GET /tokens; the users and sessions tables are for admins.

Example:

*Rows of a table, filtered.*

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "$API/data/tables/fcc_ids/rows?column=fcc_id&like=TEST&limit=5"
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "items": [{"fcc_id": "TEST-FCC", "max_eirp": 47, "created_at": 1793120787857}],
  "total": 1,
  "limit": 5,
  "offset": 0,
  "columns": ["fcc_id", "max_eirp", "created_at"]
}
```

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `table` | string | Table name (see GET /data/tables). · pattern `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` |

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `column` | string |  | Column to filter on. |
| `value` | string |  | With column: exact value. |
| `like` | string |  | With column: substring. |
| `isNull` | boolean |  | With column: only rows where it is (or is not) NULL. |
| `order` | string |  | Column to sort by (default: rowid). |
| `desc` | boolean |  | Sort descending. · default `false` |
| `limit` | integer |  | Maximum number of items to return (1–5000). · ≥ 1, ≤ 5000, default `100` |
| `offset` | integer |  | Number of items to skip. · ≥ 0, default `0` |

Responses:

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | A page of rows. | object |
| 400 | The request is invalid (validation_failed, invalid_json, bad_request) or the operation was refused (operation_failed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | No valid credentials (unauthorized), or the account is disabled (account_disabled). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The caller's role or API key does not allow this (forbidden), a browser request came from an origin that is not allowed (origin_not_allowed), or a web page reached the SAS by an unknown host name (host_not_allowed). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 404 | The resource does not exist (not_found). | [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | Too many wrong passwords from this address (too_many_attempts); retry after the Retry-After seconds. | [Error](#schema-error) |
| default | Unexpected error. | [Error](#schema-error) |

Response 200 body:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | array of object | yes |  |
| `total` | integer | yes |  |
| `limit` | integer | yes |  |
| `offset` | integer | yes |  |
| `columns` | array of string | yes |  |

### Schema: Settings

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sasHttpEnabled` | boolean | yes | Serve the SAS–CBSD protocol over plain HTTP. |
| `sasHttpPort` | integer | yes | Plain-HTTP listener port. The SAS_HTTP_PORT environment variable overrides it on every start. · ≥ 1, ≤ 65535 |
| `sasHttpsEnabled` | boolean | yes | Serve the SAS–CBSD protocol over HTTPS (WINNF-TS-0065). |
| `sasHttpsPort` | integer | yes | HTTPS listener port. The SAS_HTTPS_PORT environment variable overrides it on every start. · ≥ 1, ≤ 65535 |
| `tlsClientAuth` | `"require"` \| `"optional"` \| `"none"` | yes | `require`: WInnForum mutual TLS, the handshake fails without a trusted client certificate. `optional`: a certificate is requested but not required. `none`: no certificate is requested. |
| `tlsMinVersion` | `"TLSv1.2"` \| `"TLSv1.3"` | yes | Lowest TLS version accepted. WINNF-TS-0065 requires TLS 1.2. |
| `tlsMaxVersion` | `"TLSv1.2"` \| `"TLSv1.3"` | yes | Highest TLS version offered. |
| `tlsCipherPolicy` | `"winnforum"` \| `"extended"` \| `"nodejs-default"` | yes | `winnforum`: only the five WINNF-TS-0065 suites. `extended`: those plus common legacy suites. `nodejs-default`: whatever Node.js offers. |
| `serverCertIds` | array of string | yes | Certificates (ids from /certs, each with a private key) presented by the HTTPS listener: at most one per key type, typically one RSA and one ECDSA. Cannot be emptied while the HTTPS listener is enabled; empty at first start, when the lab PKI fills it. |
| `trustedClientCaIds` | array of string | yes | CA certificates trusted for client authentication. Empty: every CA certificate in the store. |
| `tlsCheckCrl` | boolean | yes | Check every certificate of the client chain against local revocations and imported CRLs (HTTP 403 when revoked). |
| `certRoleCheck` | `"off"` \| `"lenient"` \| `"strict"` | yes | WINNF-TS-0065 role check (responseCode 104). `lenient` rejects certificates with non-CBSD WInnForum policies; `strict` also requires ROLE_CBSD or ROLE_OPERATOR. |
| `rejectUnverifiedClientCert` | boolean | yes | With optional client authentication: answer HTTP 403 when a presented client certificate does not verify. |
| `supportedVersions` | array of string | yes | SAS protocol versions accepted in the URL path, e.g. ["v1.2"]. The first is the default. · min 1 items |
| `acceptVersionlessPaths` | boolean | yes | Accept paths without a /vX.Y/ segment (e.g. /sas-api/registration) as the first supported version. |
| `heartbeatIntervalSec` | integer | yes | heartbeatInterval returned in grant responses. · ≥ 1 |
| `transmitExpireSec` | integer | yes | transmitExpireTime = heartbeat time + this many seconds (capped at grantExpireTime). WINNF-TS-0016 allows at most 240 s. · ≥ 1, ≤ 240 |
| `grantExpireSec` | integer | yes | Grant lifetime from issue (or renewal). · ≥ 60 |
| `connectivityLostSec` | integer | yes | Time without a successful heartbeat after which the SAS terminates a CBSD's grants (specification: 7 days). · ≥ 1 |
| `versionErrorAsResponseCode` | boolean | yes | Answer unknown versions with HTTP 200 and responseCode 100 per object instead of HTTP 404. |
| `siqChannelization` | `"none"` \| `"5MHz"` \| `"10MHz"` | yes | Split spectrum-inquiry ranges into channels of this width. `none`: maximal contiguous ranges. |
| `siqIncludeDpa` | boolean | yes | Also remove spectrum blocked by active DPAs from spectrum-inquiry answers (the WInnForum tests expect DPAs to be ignored). |
| `strictOperationState` | boolean | yes | Answer 502 whenever a CBSD reports AUTHORIZED for a grant the SAS holds as GRANTED, not only before the first heartbeat. |
| `responseDelayMs` | integer | yes | Delay added to every SAS–CBSD response. · ≥ 0, ≤ 600000 |
| `includeResponseMessage` | boolean | yes | Include responseMessage in response objects. |
| `requireKnownFccId` | boolean | yes | Reject (103) FCC IDs that are not in the registry. |
| `requireKnownUserId` | boolean | yes | Reject (103) user IDs that are not in the registry. |
| `registrationPolicy` | `"strict"` \| `"lenient"` | yes | `strict`: WInnForum rules (Category B installation data must be CPI-signed or preloaded, CPI must be known and its signature valid). `lenient`: accept and log warnings. |
| `missingInstallParams` | `"pending"` \| `"register"` | yes | A registration without location data and nothing preloaded. `pending`: 200 REG_PENDING until the data is provided (WINNF-TS-0016). `register`: accept it with an unknown location. |
| `certIdentityCheck` | `"off"` \| `"warn"` \| `"enforce"` | yes | Compare the FCC ID and serial number in the client certificate with the request, and bind the cbsdId to the registering certificate. |
| `defaultFccMaxEirp` | number | yes | Certified maximum EIRP used for FCC IDs without a registry value. · ≥ -137, ≤ 100 |
| `manualApproval` | boolean | yes | Hold every new registration at REG_PENDING until approved (POST /cbsds/{cbsdId}/approve). |
| `haatCheck` | boolean | yes | Category A outdoor HAAT ≤ 6 m check (needs terrain tiles). |
| `rejectIndoorCatB` | boolean | yes | Reject Category B registrations with indoorDeployment=true (FCC Part 96.45). |
| `bandLowHz` | integer | yes | Lower edge of the band the SAS manages. · ≥ 0 |
| `bandHighHz` | integer | yes | Upper edge of the band the SAS manages. · ≥ 0 |
| `gaaRanges` | array of object | yes | Ranges available for GAA. Spectrum outside them is unavailable for GAA grants. |
| `gaaRanges[].low` | integer | yes | ≥ 0 |
| `gaaRanges[].high` | integer | yes | ≥ 0 |
| `maxEirpCatA` | number | yes | Category A EIRP limit. · ≥ -137, ≤ 100 |
| `maxEirpCatB` | number | yes | Category B EIRP limit. · ≥ -137, ≤ 100 |
| `maxGrantBandwidthHz` | integer | yes | Widest grant allowed (400 INTERFERENCE with a suggestion above it). · ≥ 1 |
| `maxGrantsPerCbsd` | integer | yes | Live grants a CBSD may hold. · ≥ 1 |
| `grantFrequencyStepHz` | integer | yes | Grant edges must be multiples of this. 0: any frequency. · ≥ 0 |
| `suggestOperationParam` | boolean | yes | Suggest an alternative operationParam with 400 and 501 answers. |
| `harnessAdminEnabled` | boolean | yes | Serve the WInnForum test-harness admin API under /admin/ on the SAS listeners. The /api/v1/harness endpoints work either way. |
| `msgLogLimit` | integer | yes | Wire-log entries kept; older ones are pruned. · ≥ 100 |
| `eventLogLimit` | integer | yes | Events kept; older ones are pruned. · ≥ 100 |
| `mapSource` | `"builtin"` \| `"local"` \| `"url"` | yes | `builtin`: bundled offline basemap. `local`: the offline tile store. `url`: an online tile server. |
| `mapLocalTiles` | string | yes | Tile set in the offline tile store (file or folder name). Empty: the first usable one. · max length 200 |
| `mapTileUrl` | string | yes | {z}/{x}/{y} tile URL template for mapSource=url. · max length 2000 |
| `mapTileAttribution` | string | yes | Attribution shown on the map. · max length 500 |
| `mapTileMaxZoom` | integer | yes | Highest zoom level the tile source serves. · ≥ 1, ≤ 22 |
| `mapDarkenTiles` | boolean | yes | Invert raster tiles in the dark theme. |
